annotations.sys_rule_justification: when you can save several people by giving up something yourself
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: That would change if I had young kids waiting on me

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Nobody is required to give up their life for others.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If one of the five were a child, though
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: there's a heaviness I can't quite label

annotations.sys_rule_justification: a person shouldn't ask others to carry a burden they won't carry
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: shouldn't ask others to carry a burden they won't carry themselves
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I can't pin down what's going on inside me

annotations.sys_rule_justification: no one should be pressured or pushed into staying
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if minutes passed and nobody spoke up, and all six of us
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Letting everyone die over a principle about consent would be wrong
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: What I feel about all this I really couldn't tell you.

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: every life counts the same, mine included
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if the boat could squeeze in six
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: Whatever I'd be feeling, though, I can't name it.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I don't think I'm bound to hand it over
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if the others had people depending on them and I didn't
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: The feeling it stirs up is hard for me to read.

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: treat people the way I'd want to be treated
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If staying wouldn't actually save anyone
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I keep reaching for a word and not finding one.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: you have a duty not to throw away your own life lightly
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If I knew for certain nobody else would stay
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: my staying would be the only thing preventing a total loss
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I can't tell what I'm feeling right now

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Five lives outweigh one. That's a principle I actually believe
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If there were any real chance of a second trip
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I can't work out what it is

annotations.sys_rule_justification: A sacrifice like this has to be freely given.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If one of the others clearly wanted to stay
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: My emotions here are strangely unreadable to me.
